title: Cheap Imitation
text: Cheap Imitation. This mop and bucket are a very poor imitation of the O'Cedar brand I currently have and love.  This has no foot pedal so you have to spin the mop by hand which doesn't really get it that dry. The handle, mop and bucket are really kind of flimsy. I got this to use outside because I didn't want to use one of my good ones for washing porches and siding. It might work OK because it doesn't matter so much if the mop is still pretty wet and drippy. The threads on this are also backwards, so be aware when you are putting it together. Counter clockwise. If you want a good bucket for house cleaning, get the O'Cedar.

product_metadata.title: Clorox Spin Dry Mop, Silver
features: SPIN DRY MOP AND BUCKET FLOOR CLEANING SYSTEM: Includes a spin mop handle, two machine washable microfiber mop heads, and a two-compartment bucket for an all-in-one floor cleaning solution

SPIN DRIVE TECHNOLOGY: Wrings out your mop quickly and efficiently with just a push of the pole, and each spin allows you to control how much water stays in the mop head for an effortless cleaning experience
MICROFIBER MOP HEAD WITH SCRUBBER: Mop head pivots 180 degrees to reach into corners and under furniture while cleaning the floors, and the center pad makes scrubbing tough spots a breeze
ANTIMICROBIAL PROTECTION: Antimicrobial mop bucket and base protect against odor-causing bacteria, mold, and mildew, and the protection will not wash off or wear away for long-lasting use
CONVENIENT AND PORTABLE: Built-in carrying handle makes it easy to transport the bucket from room to room, and the two-piece take-apart pole fits perfectly in the bucket for convenient storage
description: Keep your home clean and tidy with the Clorox Spin Dry Microfiber Mop and Bucket System. This floor cleaning set features a two-compartment bucket with Spin Drive technology to wring out your mop quickly and efficiently with just a push of the pole. Each spin allows you to control how much water stays in the mop head - spin less for a damp mop or spin more for a dry mop for an effortless cleaning experience! It also makes it easy to remove dirt and debris for a clean mop head every time. The microfiber mop head pivots 180 degrees to reach into corners and under furniture while cleaning all types of flooring surfaces, including tile, wood, laminate, and more, and the center pad on the mop head makes scrubbing tough spots a breeze. The mop heads are reusable and machine washable to extend the life of your mop, and two heads are included. The antimicrobial mop bucket and base protect against odor-causing bacteria, mold, and mildew, and the protection will not wash off or wear away for long-lasting use. With a built-in carrying handle, transporting the bucket from room to room is easy even when filled with water. The pole also breaks down into two pieces that fit perfectly in the bucket for compact and convenient storage. This set includes a spin mop handle, two microfiber mop heads, and a two-compartment bucket for an all-in-one floor cleaning solution. For over 100 years, homemakers have relied on Clorox branded products to clean and disinfect their homes. Since 2004, Clorox antibacterial cleaning tools help consumers clean and disinfect in style.
